changes_made.explanation: Normalized model names to include full version numbers (LLaVA-1.5), added explicit mention of image captioning as an output task mentioned in the paper. The paper evaluates NLG tasks including visual question answering and mentions image captioning as a downstream task.
Removed derivative metrics (Accuracy Drop, Accuracy declined ratio) as they are calculated from the base Accuracy metric. Only kept the primary evaluation metric used to assess generated outputs.
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. LLMs (GPT-4) were used only for dataset generation, not for evaluating model outputs.
No human evaluation was conducted in this paper. The paper relies exclusively on automatic metrics for evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating multi-modal LLMs' susceptibility to visual illusion when presented with spurious images. It uses synthetic and realistic images to test models on visual question answering tasks. The extraction was generally accurate but included derivative metrics that should be simplified to the base metric (Accuracy). The paper mentions but does not extensively evaluate image captioning.
